integrity: The all-integer proof is algebraic; exact symbolic identities and finite stochastic-matrix comparisons have been replayed. Finite tests are supporting checks, not an infinite proof or independent certification.
scientific_limitations: Only symmetric nonnegative stochastic matrices with permitted self-loops and uniform stationary distribution are considered.
Uniqueness is established for the automorphism-invariant optimum, not for all globally optimal matrices.
Publication-priority coverage remains limited to the inspected literature and searchable mathematical records; independent audit has not been performed.
title: Sharp fastest-mixing weights on clique-corona networks with pendant clusters
